items.subject: the isolated Wittenoom town seen from outside, its corrugated iron and asbestos cement buildings sitting small in the red desert
items.action: fine pale dust drifts slowly across the empty streets and patios as the sun rises

items.mood: stillness in a wide dusty landscape, no figure in sight, light thin and pale
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.gaze_interaction: all turned toward the front of the hall and a tall window

items.camera_angle: eye-level from the back of the room

items.mood: rounded shoulders and bowed heads in a quiet room, thin breathing audible in the stillness, soft light
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.gaze_interaction: gallery faces turned up toward the bench, the judge's eyes down on the page

items.camera_angle: eye-level from the back of the gallery
items.lighting: single soft shaft of daylight from a high window falling across the bench
items.mood: a long silent room, bent shoulders in the gallery, light falling on an empty witness stand
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: a mid-30s Spanish-Australian woman with dark hair, lying on a scanner table in a plain hospital gown, seen from the feet end
items.action: the table slides her slowly into the ring of the scanner
items.gaze_interaction: her face is turned up toward the ceiling, mostly out of view; a technician stands behind glass

items.mood: a small body in a large machine, still air, shoulders settled flat on the table, soft clinical light
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: a mid-30s Spanish-Australian woman with dark hair, seated in a plain dress beside a lung-function machine, a technician in a white coat nearby
items.action: she draws a breath and blows steadily into a tube attached to the machine
items.gaze_interaction: her eyes fixed on a paper trace unrolling from the machine, face in soft profile
items.setting: 1988 Australian hospital testing room, plain walls, a small desk

items.props_detail: a spirometer with a ribbon of paper trace
items.lighting: soft window light from one side, gentle and even
items.mood: a still seated figure, rib cage lifting with a held breath, calm pale light, quiet room
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings, fibrous strands mixed into red earth

items.gaze_interaction: focal direction pulls to the strands nearest the lens, then out across the dust

items.lens_technique: macro lens, shallow depth of field
items.lighting: soft low sun backlighting the drifting fibres
items.mood: hushed ground-level stillness, floating dust held in warm light
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: a hospital waiting room with ageing Australian and Spanish-born ex-workers and widows seated in rows, seen from behind and from a distance
items.action: they wait quietly in orderly rows, one slowly turning a page of a magazine
items.gaze_interaction: heads turned toward a closed door at the far end
items.setting: 1988 Australian hospital waiting room, vinyl chairs, a wall clock
items.color_palette: pale green, cream, faded blue vinyl, muted grey
items.props_detail: a wall clock above a closed consulting-room door
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the back of the room
items.lighting: soft overcast daylight through frosted windows
items.mood: slumped shoulders in a long quiet room, coats folded on laps, even grey light
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: the weathered police station and schoolhouse of Wittenoom, empty and dusty
items.action: dust settles on the verandahs and a loose iron sheet shifts in the breeze
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs along the empty verandah toward a shuttered door
items.setting: Wittenoom public buildings at late afternoon, tailings-surfaced yard, corrugated iron and asbestos cement walls
items.color_palette: faded ochre, weathered grey-green paint, red earth, pale blue-grey tailings
items.props_detail: a child's swing hanging still over a patch of pale tailings
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light, long calm shadows
items.mood: empty yard, motionless swing, pale dust on every surface, warm light fading
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: the whole Wittenoom townsite from above, small and quiet against vast red country
items.action: a thin veil of dust drifts across the roads and rooftops, as if smoothing the town away
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs along the grid of streets to the gorge
items.setting: Wittenoom townsite from a high ridge, airstrip and roads visible
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, grey roofs, pale blue-grey tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: the pale scar of the airstrip crossing the plain
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon golden light, calm haze
items.mood: a small settlement under a huge sky, long shadows, dust hanging in warm air
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: a roadside highway sign post on a red desert road, its board stripped bare of any name
items.action: pale rectangles and empty bolt holes show where the lettering was removed, dust settling on the blank board
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs from the blank sign down the empty road toward the horizon
items.setting: remote Western Australian road at the Wittenoom turn-off, 2007, red gravel shoulder
items.color_palette: red earth, bleached grey metal, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: empty bolt holes and a pale ghost-outline on the blank sign board
items.mood: a still blank board on a long empty road, dust in the air, pale flat light
items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: a typed government statement lying on a polished desk beside a window, a rolled map pushed aside
items.action: a page lies squared on the desk while soft light moves slowly across it
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction falls on the headline at the top of the page
items.setting: Western Australian government office, 2007, timber desk, blinds half drawn
items.color_palette: warm brown wood, cream paper, muted grey, soft daylight white
items.props_detail: a rolled map with an untouched blank corner pushed to the desk edge
items.camera_angle: high angle looking down at the desk
items.lighting: soft window light with gentle blind shadows
items.mood: an empty chair, quiet room, polished surface, cool light across clean paper

text_in_image.location: top of the page on the desk

items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: an empty parliamentary committee room with a long table and stacks of bound reports, 1992
items.action: light slowly crosses the table and the closed reports as the room stays empty
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs down the long table to a high window
items.setting: 1992 Australian parliamentary committee room, timber panelling, leather chairs pushed in
items.color_palette: deep brown timber, green leather, cream paper, muted daylight
items.props_detail: a stack of bound reports squared at the head of the table
items.camera_angle: eye-level at the end of the table
items.lighting: soft diffused daylight through tall windows, even and calm
items.mood: empty chairs pushed in, closed volumes, still dust motes in a pale shaft of light
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: a gorge creek bed in Wittenoom Gorge, pale blue-grey tailings spread across red rock and floodplain
items.action: wind lifts a thin haze of dust off the tailings and drifts it down the gorge
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction follows the pale creek bed into the gorge
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, Western Australia, red cliffs over a floodplain of tailings
items.color_palette: rust-red cliffs, blue-grey tailings, ochre, dusty pale-blue sky
items.props_detail: a rusted pipe half buried in pale tailings
items.camera_angle: high angle from the gorge wall
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light, long calm shadows across the gorge
items.mood: a huge silent gorge, pale dust drifting in still warm air, no one in sight
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: a steel barrier gate closing a red dirt road at the edge of the Wittenoom zone, tailings plain beyond
items.action: wind carries thin dust past the closed gate toward the distant road
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs through the gate onto the empty plain beyond
items.setting: entrance to the Wittenoom exclusion zone, red gravel road, distant gorge ridgeline
items.color_palette: rust-red earth, grey steel, pale blue-grey tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a chain and padlock holding the gate closed
items.lighting: soft low sun, gentle warm light
items.mood: a shut gate, a long empty road, dust moving silently in warm light
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: an old rusted bulldozer parked idle beside a huge mound of pale tailings
items.action: it sits unused in the dust while wind slowly sheds fibres from the mound's surface
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs from the idle machine up the long flank of the mound
items.setting: Wittenoom tailings field, 2016, flat red plain
items.color_palette: rust-red, oxidised orange, blue-grey tailings, dusty pale-blue sky
items.props_detail: a weathered blade resting on the ground, dust gathered in its cab
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light, calm warm tones
items.mood: idle machine, stationary mound, dust shifting in quiet air, wide empty ground
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: an elderly Anglo-Australian man, thin and stooped from illness, in a faded work shirt and wide-brim hat, seen from behind
items.action: he stands at the edge of the barrier and lets a folded paper map hang from his hand while dust blows past
items.gaze_interaction: he faces away from the camera toward the distant town and gorge
items.setting: edge of the Wittenoom exclusion zone, red plain with the distant town and gorge
items.color_palette: rust-red earth, faded khaki, pale blue-grey dust, soft golden sky
items.props_detail: a paper map fluttering in his hand while dust passes over it
items.lighting: soft golden hour light rim-lighting his shoulders and the dust
items.mood: a thin stooped figure small against a wide red plain, dust streaming past, warm settling light
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
